03 READ THE PROJECTION

Current markers

IDu (mm)v (mm)Viewport

Saved poses

    Run the independent check

    Use the supplied 8 × 8 mm coupon. Capture the zero pose, select 90° azimuth / 60° tilt, keep the supplied tight crop (±1.5 mm vertically), and capture again. Widen the crop to ±5 mm and capture the same pose a third time. The mark 4 mm off-axis should project to (0, 2) mm: outside the tight crop but inside the wide one. The central mark stays at the origin; another mark, directly above it by 1 mm, shifts to v = −0.866 mm. Return to zero before opening the drawer to recover the coupon.

    All coordinates are computed, not microscope measurements. The projection first rotates the coupon coordinates (x, y) by its azimuth to (x′, y′), then computes u = x′ and v = y′ cos θ − h sin θ for a tilt θ and marker height h relative to the tilt axis. The procedure does not simulate detectors, actual electron or ion imaging, collisions, or milling.
